content_sections.heading: Where and How to Send
content_sections.text: Eligible candidates must submit their applications directly in person along with copies of educational and experience certificates to the following postal and office address: District Social Welfare Officer, District Social Welfare Office, District Treasury First Floor, (Post Office Opposite), District Collectorate Campus, Ramanathapuram. Applications sent through delayed postal methods or received after the stipulated date and time (5:45 PM on 26 November 2026) will be summarily rejected by the District Collector, Ramanathapuram.

content_sections.heading: Posts, Eligibility and Pay
content_sections.text: Must possess a Postgraduate degree in Sociology, Science, Biology, Nutrition, Medicine, Health Management, Social Work, or Rural Management. Must have at least 3 years of prior work experience working with government or non-government organisations (NGOs) in a similar capacity. Maximum age limit: 40 years . faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are available in this notification?
faq.answer: There is exactly 1 vacancy available for the District Women's Empowerment Centre Coordinator post.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to submit the application?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application is 26 November 2026 by 5:45 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What is the required educational qualification for the Coordinator post?
faq.answer: Candidates must hold a Postgraduate degree in Sociology, Science, Biology, Nutrition, Medicine, Health Management, Social Work, or Rural Management.

faq.question: Q4. Is any prior work experience required?
faq.answer: Yes, candidates must have at least 3 years of prior experience working with government or non-government organizations.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for applicants?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Coordinator position is 40 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the monthly salary offered?
faq.answer: The selected candidate will receive a consolidated monthly salary of Rs. 35,000/-.

faq.question: Q7. How should the application be submitted?
faq.answer: Applications must be submitted directly in person along with relevant certificates to the District Social Welfare Office, Ramanathapuram.
